name: Pop-up Book
summary: A hardcover pop-up book where metric stands rise from the gutter and the anomaly pops up in coral with a pull-tab to roll back.
look: Cream paper stock, visible page edges and gutter shadows on a warm walnut desk. Teal cloth cover, V-fold stands with fold shadows, one coral pull-tab per spread.

components.name: Spread
components.role: two CSS-3D page planes hinged at the gutter, cream stock with a gutter shadow

components.name: V-fold stand
components.role: an upright card that rotates 0→90° off the page; carries a metric or the logo

components.name: Fold foot
components.role: skewed shadow strip at each stand's base that sells the paper hinge

components.name: Sunburst die-cut
components.role: alternating teal-tint / cream rays behind the reveal medallion

components.name: Strut + flag
components.role: a paper strut lifts the anomaly card above the coral bar

components.name: Pull-tab
components.role: the human action and the CTA: coral paper tab that slides out of the page edge

motion.name: Page turn
motion.how: rotateY 0 → −180°, power2.inOut 0.9 s; the page lands flat on the downbeat, so start it 0.9 s early (≈2 beats at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Pop-rise
motion.how: stands rotateX 90 → 0°, back.out(1.4) 0.45 s, staggered 0.12 s by depth row so each row lands on an eighth note

motion.name: Linkage
motion.how: the pull-tab's x drives the flag and bar rotation (tab 0→120 px maps to flag 0→90°), easing none — the reader's pull is the rhythm

story: Hook: a spread of pop-up dashboard stands rises while the headline asks how many you checked. Reveal: a page turn on the drop raises a sunburst and the Acme medallion with an “Acme Pulse” banner. Proof: metric bars pop up; the checkout bar is short and coral, a flag unfolds reading “Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231”, and the human pulls the “Roll back” tab. CTA: the book closes on a teal cover — “Caught before customers noticed.” — with a coral “Start free” pull-tab.
adapt: Turn each of your product's screens into one spread and each key card into a stand; the thing your product catches is the stand that pops up in the alert colour, and your main action becomes the pull-tab.

fit.risk: Text on angled paper shrinks; keep copy on camera-facing stands and the flat cover.
